custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ondo documents issuer Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited as a bankruptcy-remote SPV with full segregation of assets, books, and accounts from Ondo Finance Inc. and the Ondo Foundation group, and Ankura Trust Company holds a first-priority perfected security interest in the backing assets as verification and collateral agent with contractual wind-down authority. The custodial broker-dealers and bank counterparties, provider shares, custodian-level account segregation, and rehypothecation terms are not identified in the reviewed public materials.
